knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Working top to bottom stops splashes from landing on finished surfaces.
Contact time is product-specific and set by the label.
Appearance does not prove disinfection. Checks and product use must be verified separately.

practicalCriteria: Follows the set-up, top-to-bottom sequence in a timed simulated bathroom.
Observes contact time and rinsing directions for the product used.
Leaves the floor free of uncontrolled wet-slip hazards at the end.
Completes a walk-through check and records it.
passRule: Sequence followed without a critical breach, contact time observed, and no uncontrolled slip hazard at completion. Observed by an assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Uncontrolled wet-slip hazard left in an occupied area
